versions.content: BswModuleEntity reentrancy level With the optional at- tribute reentrancyLevel a BswModuleEntity can state its implemented reen- trancy level within the limits given by its interface(see [constr_4077]). This attribute is especially targeted at multicore scenarios. If this attribute is omitted, reentrancy is assumed to be implemented as defined by the attribute BswModuleEntity . implementedEntry . isReentrant , in which case true means single core reentrancy.
